Subject (in full)........................................ Case against Yu Ai Ling.

Made by.................... Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by The Robertson, Lupt.

Yu Ai Ling was wanted by the Nanking Authorities
on a charge of being a member of the Kiangsu Communist Pro-
vincial Government. He was arrested by the Bubbling Well
Police on Dec. 14, 1931 and handed over to the Defense Com-
missioner who sent him to Nanking. In December 1931 Chiang
Kai-shek resigned and the Military Court attached to his
office was abolished. Yu Ai Ling was consequently transferred
to the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow. There he was detained
until about March 1932 when owing to the impending danger to
Soochow
/during the recent hostilities the prisoner was transferred to
the 3rd Branch of the High Court in the French Concession..
How this was arranged is not known but evidently the Soochow
Court has lost the file of this case and thinking that it
originates from Shanghai sent the prisoner to the French Con-
cession. The case against Tsai Fee has nothing to do with Yu
Ai Ling. Rumours are current that Yu Ai Ling is endeavouring
to secure his release from the French Court. If desired, I
shall ascertain from Wang Oo Ching as to how the case stands
at present and to discover whether he can arrange to have the
man sent back to Nanking.

B
A

Tan Shao Liang
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

由.................... 谭绍良督察 制作 经 The Robertson, Lupt. 转发

南京当局以涉嫌担任江苏省共产党省政府成员为由通缉
俞爱林。他于1931年12月14日被静安寺路警署逮捕，并移交
给防卫专员，后者将其送往南京。1931年12月，蒋介石辞职，
其所属的军事法庭被撤销。因此，俞爱林被转送至苏州的江
苏高等法院。他在那里被拘留至1932年3月左右，由于近期
敌对行动导致苏州面临迫在眉睫的危险 /囚犯被转送至法租
界的高等法院第三分院。具体安排方式不详，但显然苏州法
院遗失了该案的卷宗，并认为该案源自上海，遂将囚犯送往
法租界。针对蔡菲（Tsai Fee）的案件与俞爱林无关。目前有
谣言称，俞爱林正试图从法国法院获得释放。如有需要，我
将向王OO清查明案件目前的状况，并探询他是否能安排将该
人送回南京。

Subject (in full) Despatch dated May 6, 1932, from the 3rd Branch Kiangsu
High Court (French Concession) addressed to Bubbling Well Station res:
Arrest of Yui Ai Ling(俞愛林) alias Yui Oen Ling(俞景林).
Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by D. I. Ross.

With reference to the despatch dated May 6, 1932,
from the 3rd Branch Kiangsu High Court, on the subject of one
Yui Ai Ling(俞愛林), I have to report that on December 9, 1931,
a letter was received from Captain Teng Ching Min(鄧警銘),
Chief Intelligence Officer of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters,
requesting the Settlement Police to make investigations regarding
one Ai Ling(愛林), native of Ningpo, employed as a brass-smith
at the Tramway Depot, Hart Road, who had been implicated by
a communist named Hsu Wei San(許畏三) as being the "Chairman
of the Communist General Labour Union". Hsu, who was formerly
connected with the "Federation of Labour Unions", a communist
organ, was arrested by the Soong Wu Military Authorities at
No. 70 Chuan Zoen Li(存善里), Jessfield, O.O.L. on December 8,
1931.

During the night of December 14/15, 1931, Yui Ai Ling
(俞愛林) together with a female named Wang Yeu Tseng(王月貞)
alias Dong Sih Lai(唐雪蘭) were brought to Bubbling Well Station
from No. 1214 Hart Road in the custody of a police officer
acting on a report received from a tenant at this address that
they were suspicious characters. On the early morning of
December 15, the late Wong Ping(王斌), Detective of the
Soong Wu Military Headquarters, called at Bubbling Well Station
and identified Yui Ai Ling as being identical with the person
who formed the subject of Captain Teng's letter and that he was
wanted by the Chinese Authorities on a charge of propagating
communism, and the female as being the wife of Lau Wong(老王)
alias Liu Ching San(刘金山) alias Wong Ching San(王金山),
another notorious communist, who, it subsequently transpired,
had absconded from No. 1214 Hart Road during the night of

主题（全称） 1932年5月6日来自江苏高等法院第三分院（法租界）致静安寺路警署的公函，事由：
逮捕余爱林（Yui Ai Ling，俞愛林），又名余景林（Yui Oen Ling，俞景林）。
由 .................... 和 .................... 制作 经 D. I. Ross 转发。

关于1932年5月6日江苏高等法院第三分院就余爱林（俞愛林）
一事发出的公函，兹报告如下：1931年12月9日，收到宋武军
事总部情报主任邓警铭（Teng Ching Min）上尉的来信，请求
租界警方调查一名叫爱林（Ai Ling）的人，宁波籍，受雇于
赫德路电车车厂担任铜匠，被一名叫许畏三（Hsu Wei San）的
共产党人指认为“共产党总工会主席”。许曾与共产党组织“工
会联合会”有关联，于1931年12月8日在极司菲尔路（Jessfield）
O.O.L. 存善里70号被宋武军事当局逮捕。

1931年12月14/15日夜，余爱林（俞愛林）与一名叫王月贞
（Wang Yeu Tseng）、又名唐雪兰（Dong Sih Lai）的女子，由
一名警官从赫德路1214号带至静安寺路警署，该警官是依据该
地址一名租户的报告行动的，报告称他们是可疑人物。12月15
日清晨，宋武军事总部侦探王斌（Wong Ping，已故）来到静安
寺路警署，指认余爱林即为邓上尉信中提及之人，并称中国当
局以宣传共产主义罪名通缉他；同时指认该女子为老王（Lau
Wong）、又名刘金山（Liu Ching San）、又名王金山（Wong
Ching San）的妻子，后者是另一名臭名昭著的共产党人，后
来证实他已于当晚从赫德路1214号潜逃。

December 14. Lau Wong, who is reported to be the "Secretary
of the Communist Section of the Shanghai Municipal Workers'
General Union", is also wanted by the Chinese Authorities on a
charge of communist activities. As a result of a watch
maintained at the latter address, Liu Kwei Yuan(刘窥园), elder
brother of Lau Wong(老王), also a communist, and a female
named Sung Wong Sz(孙王氏) were arrested while entering the
premises later in the day (December 15).
On December 15, Yui Ai Ling's(俞爱林) home at No.
215 South Chengtu Road was accordingly searched on the authority
of a warrant, and a note book containing pencilled notes relating
to accounts of the "General Labour Union" and the "Municipal
General Federation" was seized.
In the room at No. 1214 Hart Road, which was hurriedly
vacated by Lau Wong(老王), an account book containing the
following significant items showing Yui Ai Ling's connections
with the Party was seized:-
"1/8 Received from Lien Kyi(联记) (?Federation of Labour
Unions) through Oen Ling(安林), $100.
"3/9 Received from Lien Kyi(联记), through Oen Ling(安林),
$80. "
Further investigations revealed that Yui Ai Ling(俞爱林)
had rented, on behalf of Lau Wong, a dwelling house at No. 10
Wai Ying Lee(换荫里), off Wuting Road. Enquiries at this
address showed that Lau Wong had resided there together with his
wife from August 15 to December 5, 1931. An agreement of lease
in the name of Yui Oen Ling(俞安林) was subsequently obtained
by the Police; and Liu Kwei Yuan( 3rd accused), according to
his own statement, had lived at No. 10 Wai Ying Lee, Wuting Road,

1931年12月16日，所有被告被提审至江苏高等法院第二分

2) 在其成都南路216号家中发现一本笔记本，内含关于共产
党组织“总工会”和“市政总联合会”账目的笔记。
3) 在赫德路1214号发现一本账簿，其中包含通过余爱林
（俞愛林）的别名“晏林”（Oen Ling）从联合会收款的记

Despatch dated May 6, 1932, from the 3rd Branch Kiangsu
High Court (French Concession) addressed to Bubbling Well Station re:
Arrest of Yui Ai Ling(俞愛林) alias Yui Oen Ling(俞恩林).
// and D. I. Ross.

With reference to the despatch dated May 6, 1932,
from the 3rd Branch Kiangsu High Court, on the subject of one
Yui Ai Ling(俞愛林), I have to report that on December 9, 1931,
a letter was received from Captain Teng Ching Min(鄭警銘),
Chief Intelligence Officer of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters,
requesting the Settlement Police to make investigations regarding
one Ai Ling(愛林), native of Ningpo, employed as a brass-smith
at the Tramway Depot, Hart Road, who had been implicated by
a communist named Hsu Wei San(許畏三) as being the "Chairman
of the Communist General Labour Union". Hsu, who was formerly
connected with the "Federation of Labour Unions", a communist
organ, was arrested by the Soong Wu Military Authorities at
No. 70 Chuan Zoen Li(川善里), Jessfield, O.C.L. on December 8,
1931.

During the night of December 14/15, 1931, Yui Ai Ling
(俞愛林) together with a female named Wang Yeu Tseng(王月貞)
alias Dong Sih Lai(唐雪蘭) were brought to Bubbling Well Station
from No. 1214 Hart Road in the custody of a police officer
acting on a report received from a tenant at this address that
they were suspicious characters. On the early morning of
December 15, the late Wong Ping(王斌), Detective of the
Soong Wu Military Headquarters, called at Bubbling Well Station
and identified Yui Ai Ling as being identical with the person
who formed the subject of Captain Teng's letter and that he was
wanted by the Chinese Authorities on a charge of propagating
communism, and the female as being the wife of Lau Wang(老王)
alias Liu Ching San(劉金山) alias Wong Ching San(王金山),
another notorious communist, who, it subsequently transpired,
had absconded from No. 1214 Hart Road during the night of

关于：江苏省高等法院第三分院（法租界）于1932年5月6日发往静安寺捕房的公函，涉及逮捕俞愛林（Yui Ai Ling），又名俞恩林（Yui Oen Ling）。
// 及副督察罗斯（D. I. Ross）。

兹就江苏省高等法院第三分院于1932年5月6日发出的关于俞愛林（Yui Ai Ling）一案的公函，报告如下：1931年12月9日，本处收到宋武军事指挥部首席情报官郑警銘（Teng Ching Min）上尉来信，请求租界警方对一名名为愛林（Ai Ling）的宁波籍人士进行调查。该人在哈同路（Hart Road）电车车厂担任铜匠，被一名名为許畏三（Hsu Wei San）的共产党人指认为“共产党总工会主席”。許氏此前曾与共产党组织“工会联合会”有关联，于1931年12月8日在越界筑路区极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）川善里70号被宋武军方当局逮捕。

1931年12月14/15日夜间，俞愛林（Yui Ai Ling）与一名名为王月貞（Wang Yeu Tseng）、又名唐雪蘭（Dong Sih Lai）的女子，由一名警员从哈同路1214号带至静安寺捕房。此举系依据该地址一名租户的报告，称此二人形迹可疑。12月15日清晨，宋武军事指挥部已故侦探王斌（Wong Ping）造访静安寺捕房，指认俞愛林即为郑上尉信中提及之人，并指出中国当局正以宣传共产主义罪名通缉此人；同时指认该女子为老王（Lau Wang）、又名劉金山（Liu Ching San）、又名王金山（Wong Ching San）之妻。后者系另一名臭名昭著的共产党人，据后查悉，其已于12月14日夜间从哈同路1214号潜逃。

page_data.en:
2.
December 14. Lau Wong, who is reported to be the "Secretary
of the Communist Section of the Shanghai Municipal Workers'
General Union", is also wanted by the Chinese Authorities on a
charge of communist activities. As a result of a watch
maintained at the latter address, Liu Kwei Yuan(刘观阁), elder
brother of Lau Wong(老王 ), also a communist, and a female
named Sung Wong Sz(孙王氏 ) were arrested while entering the
premises later in the day (December 15).
On December 15, Yui Ai Ling's(俞爱林) home at No.
216 South Chengtu Road was accordingly searched on the authority
of a warrant, and a note book containing pencilled notes relating
to accounts of the "General Labour Union" and the "Municipal
General Federation" was seized.
In the room at No. 1214 Hart Road, which was hurriedly
vacated by Lau Wong(老王 ), an account book containing the
following significant items showing Yui Ai Ling's connections
with the Party was seized:-
"1/8 Received from Lien Kyi(联记 ) (?Federation of Labour
Unions) through Oen Ling(安林 ), $100.
"3/9 Received from Lien Kyi(联记 ), through Oen Ling(安林),
$80. "
Further investigations revealed that Yui Ai Ling(俞爱林)
had rented, on behalf of Lau Wong, a dwelling house at No. 10
Wai Ying Lee(槐荫里), off Wating Road. Enquiries at this
address showed that Lau Wong had resided there together with his
wife from August 15 to December 5, 1931. An agreement of lease
in the name of Yui Oen Ling(俞安林) was subsequently obtained
by the Police; and Liu Kwei Yuan( 3rd accused), according to
his own statement, had lived at No. 10 Wai Ying Lee, Wuting Road.
page_data.zh:
2.
据报道，老王（Lau Wong）担任“上海市总工会共产党分部秘书”，中国当局亦以从事共产党活动罪名对其通缉。由于在该地址持续监视，老王的哥哥、同为共产党人的刘观阁（Liu Kwei Yuan，原文此处括号内注为老王之兄）以及一名名为孙王氏（Sung Wong Sz）的女子，于当日（12月15日）稍晚进入该寓所时被逮捕。
12月15日，警方凭搜查令对俞愛林（Yu Ai Ling）位于成都南路216号的住所进行了搜查，查获一本笔记本，其中包含用铅笔记录的关于“总工会”和“市总联合会”账目的笔记。
在老王（Lau Wong）匆忙撤离的哈同路1214号房间内，查获一本账簿，其中包含以下显示俞愛林与党派关系的重要条目：
“1/8 通过安林（Oen Ling）从联记（Lien Kyi）（？工会联合会）收到100元。
“3/9 通过安林（Oen Ling）从联记（Lien Kyi）收到80元。”
进一步调查显示，俞愛林（Yui Ai Ling）曾代表老王在瓦亭路（Wating Road）槐荫里（Wai Ying Lee）10号租赁了一处住宅。对该地址的查询表明，老王与其妻子曾于1931年8月15日至12月5日期间居住于此。警方随后获取了一份以俞安林（Yui Oen Ling）名义签署的租赁契约；据第三被告刘观阁（Liu Kwei Yuan）自述，他在搬至瓦亭路420号之前，曾在瓦亭路槐荫里10号居住。

page_data.en:
3.
for about two months prior to his removal to 420 Wuting Road.
A search of Liu's quarters at 420 Wuting Road, also made on
December 15, resulted in the finding of a large quantity of
pro-Communist books in the English and Chinese languages.
Upon being brought before the Second Branch Kiangsu
High Court on December 16, 1931, all accused with the exception
of the 4th, an elderly Chinese female who was released, were
ordered to be extradited to the Chinese Authorities.
Points implicating Yui Ai Ling(俞愛林) alias Yui Oen
Ling(俞安林) are tabulated hereunder:-
1) Implicated by Hsu Wei San(许景三), a communist formerly
connected with the "Federation of Labour Unions", who was
arrested by the Soong Wu Military Authorities, to the effect
that Yui Ai Ling is the Chairman of the General Labour
Federation, a Communist organ.
2) The finding at his home at No. 216 South Chengtu Road, of
a note book containing notes relating to accounts of the
"General Labour Union" and "Municipal General Federation",
communist organizations.
3) The finding at No. 1214 Hart Road of an account book
containing entries relating to the receipt of money from
the Federation through "Oen Ling"(安林), an alias of Yui
Ai Ling(俞愛林).
4) The renting of premises No. 10 Hai Ying Li(槐蔭里) off Wuting
Road on behalf of Lau Wong(老王), a notorious communist
wanted by the Chinese Authorities.
5) Admitted in his statement to the Police as having first made
the acquaintance of Lau Wong(老王) in Canton about 11
years ago and having had dealings with him in May, 1931, in
Shanghai.
Officer i/c S. B.                                      B. L.

约两个月。12月15日对刘位于瓦亭路420号住所的搜查中，发现了大量中英文版的亲共书籍。
1931年12月16日，所有被告（除第四被告，一名获释的中国老年妇女外）在江苏高等法院第二分院受审时，被裁定引渡给中国当局。
涉及俞愛林（Yui Ai Ling），又名俞安林（Yui Oen Ling）的要点汇总如下：
1) 被前“工会联合会”成员、已被宋武军方当局逮捕的共产党人許景三（Hsu Wei San，注：前文为許畏三）指认，称俞愛林是共产党组织“总工会”的主席。
2) 在其成都南路216号家中搜获一本笔记本，内含关于共产党组织“总工会”和“市总联合会”账目的笔记。
3) 在哈同路1214号搜获一本账簿，其中有通过俞愛林的化名“安林”（Oen Ling）从联合会收款的记录。
4) 代表被中国当局通缉的著名共产党人老王（Lau Wong），租赁瓦亭路旁槐蔭里（Hai Ying Li）10号的房屋。
5) 在向警方所作的供词中承认，约11年前在广州初次结识老王（Lau Wong），并于1931年5月在上海与其有过往来。

ADDRESSED TO THE BBUBLING WELL POLICE STATION
FROM THE 3RD. BR'NCH KIANGSU HIGH COURT.

With reference to the case against Tsar Fee et al,
tried in this Court on suspicion of "Endangering the Republic",
one of the accused named Yu Ai Ling states the he was admitted to
Gaol by mistake, as he was only a guarantor to Liu Ching Sung in
leasing a house, and that he was not arrested, but surrendered to
the Police with Wong Hao Tsung on the 15-12-31.

This Court is unable to believe this statement unless
it is reliably confirmed, therefore I hereby ask you to inform us,
whether the above statement is genuine or not, at your earliest
convenience.

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special

were issued, I have to state that according to information in pos-

the "Secretary of the communist section of the Shanghai Municipal
Workers' General Union".

Enquiries made at Algar & Co, No 5 Hongkong Road, agents
for the house No 10 Wa Ying Li (槐里) off Wuting Road, where
Lau Wong formerly resided, show that one Yui Oen Ling (俞安林)
was the registered tenant of this house from August 15 till Decem-
ber 5, 1931, the rental being $ 32 per month. Wong Hao Tsung (王浩春)
proprietor of the "Yong Tai Han" money exchange, tobacco and food
shop at No F.1422 Hert Road, went security for Yui Oen Ling.

On December 14 the Yong Tai Han shop was visited by
members of the Special Branch on three occasions, with a view to
eliciting information regarding Lau Wong's whereabouts, but Wong
Hao Tsung, the proprietor of the shop, was absent in each instance.
At about 5 p.m. the same day a note was left at the shop request-
ing Wong Hao Tsung to call at this office at 9 a.m. on December
15.

At about 2 p.m. on December 15 D.I. Ross received a te-
lephone message from Bubbling Well police station to the effect
that two Chinese, - one male and one female, were detained in con-

参照特别科科长于1931年12月11日发出的备忘录，主题是关于一名老王（Lau Wong），又名刘金山（Lieu Kyung San），上述逮捕令即针对此人签发，我必须陈述，根据宋武军事司令部掌握的情报，此人是“上海市总工会共产党分部书记”。

经向阿尔加公司（Algar & Co，香港路5号）查询，该公司是武定路旁槐荫里（Wa Ying Li）10号房屋的代理行，老王此前曾居住于此。查询结果显示，俞安林（Yui Oen Ling）是该房屋从1931年8月15日至12月5日的注册租户，租金为每月32美元。哈同路F.1422号“永泰亨”钱庄、烟草食品店店主王浩春（Wong Hao Tsung）为俞安林作了担保。

12月14日，特别科成员三次光顾永泰亨店铺，旨在获取有关老王下落的信息，但每次该店店主王浩春均不在场。同日约下午5时，在该店留下一张便条，要求王浩春于12月15日上午9时来本办公室。

12月15日下午2时许，罗斯巡官（D.I. Ross）接到静安寺警署的电话消息，称有两名中国人——一男一女——因涉嫌此事被拘留。

经第二科人员随后的调查，查明槐荫里10号房屋是由俞安林代老王租赁的，后者出于显而易见的原因不愿以自己的名义租赁该处。看来

当王浩春收到上述便条时（1931年12月14日晚8时许），他立即将其出示给俞安林并要求解释。后者随后承认，他从未居住在武定路槐荫里10号，而是代表与其友好多年的老王以他的名义租赁了该房屋。俞随即请求王陪同他前往哈同路1214号的“董玉记”裁缝店，老王当时与其妻子占据着楼上的前间。到达该地址后，俞向老王解释了此事，前者在读过便条后，似乎唤醒了妻子，两人一起开始收拾行李，准备匆忙离开。这一举动引起了裁缝店店主董寿祥（Dong Zu Xiang）的怀疑，他于晚上11点50分向静安寺警署报告了其租户的可疑行为。警察到达后发现，老王已经潜逃。然而，其妻王月贞（Wong Yeu Tseng），又名冬雪兰（Dong Shih Len），又名唐雪兰（Tang Shih Lan）以及俞安林被拘留，并通知了罗斯巡官。
随后对哈同路1214号的探访导致在该处所外逮捕了老王的哥哥刘巍园（LieuKwei Yuen），并对该处所进行监视，结果逮捕了一名名为孙王氏（Sung Wong Sz）的女子。
随后获得搜查令，搜查武定路武定坊420号（Lieu Kwei Yuen的住所）和成都南路宝裕坊216号（Yui Oen Ling的住所）。两处均于当天上午11点至下午2点之间遭到突击搜查。

3rd accused going to this house so they arrested him. He resides
at 420 Wuting Road. At about 10 p.m. the 4th accused was arrest
ed by a watchman who was left there when he saw the 4th accused

D.I.R — 16.12.31

Communist bases raided - four arrests

While making investigation into the whereabouts of one
Lau Wong (老王) alias Liou Kyung-san (刘景山), for whose
arrest on a charge of being an active communist a warrant has
been issued by the Shanghai Special District Court, the
Municipal Police on December 15 arrested Wong Yeu-tsing (王月貞)
wife of the missing man following the seizure of a small quanti-
ty of communist literature in her home at 1214 Hart Road.
One Yu Eu-ling (俞玉林), residing at 216 South Chengtu Road,
was also taken into custody, following the discovery at this
address of a notebook containing an account of monies received
from the General Labour Union. These arrests led to the appre-
hension of one Liou Kuei-yuen (刘窥园), said to be a brother
of the absconded Lau Wong outside 1214 Hart Road revealed a
large quantity of communist literature. A watch kept on 1214
Hart Road resulted in the arrest later in the day of a female
named Sung Wong Sz (宋王氏).

突袭共产党据点 - 四人被捕

在调查一名叫老王 (Lau Wong)，又名刘景山 (Liou Kyung-san) 的下落时，上海特区法院已因其涉嫌为活跃共产党员而签发逮捕令，公共租界警务处于12月15日在其位于哈特路1214号的住所查获少量共产主义文献后，逮捕了这名失踪男子的妻子王月貞 (Wong Yeu-tsing)。
在于成都南路216号发现一本记录从总工会收到款项的笔记本后，居住在该地址的俞玉林 (Yu Eu-ling) 也被拘留。这些逮捕行动导致了对一名叫刘窥园 (Liou Kuei-yuen) 的人的抓获，据称他是潜逃的老王的兄弟。在哈特路1214号外发现了大量共产主义文献。对哈特路1214号的监视导致当天晚些时候逮捕了一名名为宋王氏 (Sung Wong Sz) 的女子。

Subject (in full) Execution of Shanghai Special District Court Warrants Nos.
3678 and 3681.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

In accordance with the instructions contained in warrants
Nos.3678 and 3681 issued by the Shanghai Special District Court
at the request of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters to arrest a
communist named Lau Wong ( 老 王 ) alias Lieu Kyung San ( 劉金山 )
and to search and seize certain communistic literature in "the
premises No.10 Wa Ying Li ( 懷蔭里 ) Ferry Road, off Wuting Road",
the above address was visited at 11 a.m. on December 10, 1931 by
members of the Special Branch accompanied by D.S. Nancarrow and
representatives of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters.

From enquiries made it was ascertained that Lau Wong
and his wife had been living at this house, the construction of
which was completed in May 1931, from July until December 5, when
they vacated the premises. The present whereabouts of Lau Wong
are unknown.

A search of the premises which is unoccupied, failed to
disclose anything of an incriminating nature.

According to Koo Zung Zien ( 顧盛泉 ), 42, native of
Soochow, employed as watchman in the alleyway in question, Lau
Wong whom he believed to be a metal shop employee, commenced
removing his furniture by wheelbarrows on December 3rd.
Algar & Co. No.5 Hongkong Road are the agents for the premises,
which is a Chinese dwelling.

Lau Wong's description is as follows:-
Age about 40, height 5'5", stout build, round face, dark complexion,
speaks Canton dialect.

根据上海特区地方法院应宋武军事指挥部请求签发的第3678号和3681号传票中的指示，逮捕一名名为老王（Lau Wong），别名刘金山（Lieu Kyung San）的共产党员，并在“吴定路旁斐伦路怀荫里（Wa Ying Li）10号的处所”搜查并没收某些共产主义文献，特务科成员在 D.S. Nancarrow 和宋武军事指挥部代表的陪同下，于1931年12月10日上午11点访问了上述地址。

经查询得知，老王及其妻子自1931年5月竣工以来，一直居住在该房屋内，从7月住至12月5日搬离。目前老王的下落不明。

对该空置处所的搜查未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

据顾盛泉（Koo Zung Zien），42岁，苏州人，受雇为该弄堂看门人称，他认为老王是五金店雇员，于12月3日开始用手推车搬运家具。阿尔加公司（Algar & Co.），香港路5号，是该处所的代理行，该处所为中式住宅。
